listing.title: My First Jungle & Safari Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Jungle and Safari Pages – Tiger, Zebra, Hippo, Sloth & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly jungle and safari animals!

Little hands color 30 pages from the jungle and the safari, from a tiger, a sloth and a crocodile to a zebra, a hippo and a safari truck. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines and a happy face, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Jungle animals: Tiger, Jaguar, Gorilla, Orangutan, Sloth, Lemur, Chameleon, Anteater, Capybara, Crocodile and Hornbill
  • Safari animals: Zebra, Hippo, Rhino, Cheetah, Meerkat, Warthog, Gazelle, Buffalo, Baboon, Hyena and Pangolin
  • Jungle and safari things: Safari Truck, Camera, Hot Air Balloon, Acacia Tree, Waterfall, Jungle Leaf, Hibiscus and Tree House
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
